name: -6AN Flare to 5/16" Quick Connect Adapter
title: -6AN Flare to 5/16" Quick Connect Adapter
description:
The -6AN Flare to 5/16" Quick Connect Adapter is a high-performance component engineered for demanding automotive applications. -6AN Male Flare to 5/16" Male Quick Connect Fuel Adapter

Allows for seamless conversion of OEM-Style female quick-connect fittings to AN lines in Fuel and Vacuum systems.

Technical Specifications:

-6AN male flare (37* JIC)

5/16"(8mm) male quick connect

E85 & Racefuel compatible

Signature polished, black anodized finish

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision machined for rigorous track and street applications.
